case_title: When Permission Required Was Mistaken for Permission Granted
event_scope: One bounded local repository-control repair and recorded staged-state replay

public_claims.statement: A live local repository gate blocked a 127-path staged integration after classifying two authority-related records as authority overclaims; the same refusal also recorded a separate receipt-storage defect.
public_claims.required_limitation: The original refusal recorded two authorization-classification findings plus one separate fail-closed receipt-storage internal error; it must not be presented as a single-cause event.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: One 127-path local staged state received a blocking gate result with two authority findings and one receipt-storage internal error.
prohibited_inferences: the refusal had only one cause
the authority findings were correct merely because the gate blocked

public_claims.statement: Adjudication found that one record described permission still required and the other preserved a historical state in which permission had been withheld; neither record was a current permission grant.
public_claims.required_limitation: This conclusion is bounded to the two adjudicated records.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The two identified records were classified as an unmet authority condition and an immutable historical authority state, not as current grants.
prohibited_inferences: all authority-bearing language is a non-grant
all historical records are safe to ignore
the gate should have been bypassed

public_claims.statement: The repair changed exactly five paths: one gate implementation, two existing test modules, and two evidence records; neither triggering source record was edited.
public_claims.required_limitation: The adjudication records bound the five-file repair scope; independent proof of the original repair authorization beyond the adjudication record was not preserved in the cited commit.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The commit-preserved adjudication and validation records show a five-path repair and unchanged triggering source artifacts.
prohibited_inferences: independent proof of the original repair authorization beyond the adjudication record
runtime, downstream execution, product, or commit authority

public_claims.statement: The repaired classifier distinguished required, requested, denied, absent, granted, and ambiguous authority states, and recognized specifically bounded historical states as non-operative, while retaining fail-closed treatment for unsupported or ambiguous authority.
public_claims.required_limitation: The authorization-state coverage is bounded to the implemented fixtures, rules, and evaluated repository state.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The focused implementation and tests distinguished the seven stated authority meanings and kept declared unsupported or ambiguous cases blocked.

public_claims.statement: The focused repair suite passed 88 tests and 200 subtests with zero failures, errors, or skips.
public_claims.required_limitation: Focused passing tests are not a production reliability benchmark.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The declared focused local repair suite passed in the recorded environment.

public_claims.statement: The validation record reports that an internal authorization-state review passed all 58 declared cases against recorded gate and test hashes without mutating state.
public_claims.required_limitation: The commit-preserved record does not independently prove reviewer role separation or third-party validation.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The validation record reports that fifty-eight of fifty-eight declared authorization-state cases passed an internal review against recorded artifact hashes without reviewer mutation.

public_claims.statement: After repair, replay of the recorded 127-path staged surface returned allow with zero blocking findings, zero structured authority blocks, and zero internal errors.
public_claims.required_limitation: The replay result is bounded to the recorded 127-path staged surface and repaired local gate.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The recorded 127-path staged-surface replay passed the repaired gate with the stated zero counts.

public_claims.statement: The final 132-path staged state returned allow with zero blocks, zero internal errors, and no gate bypass.
public_claims.required_limitation: A passing local gate result did not itself authorize a commit, downstream execution, runtime activation, deployment, or external action.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The complete 132-path local staged state passed the repaired live gate with the stated zero counts and no bypass.

public_claims.statement: Eight known repository-control baseline failures and one inherited historical failure in an adjacent suite remained visible; no universal full-suite pass was claimed.
public_claims.required_limitation: The authority repair resolved its identified defect without resolving those residual failures.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: The recorded broader runs retained eight known baseline failures and one inherited historical failure while reporting no new repair-linked failures.

public_claims.statement: The repaired integration was later recorded in a two-parent merge commit on a dedicated integration branch that was not part of the local mainline at internal verification on 2026-07-29.
public_claims.required_limitation: The earlier repair receipt neither authorized nor performed that later commit.
public_claims.claim_ceiling: One private two-parent integration commit records the repaired state and remained outside the verified local mainline.
prohibited_inferences: the repair receipt authorized the commit
the commit was merged to main

claim_ceiling: A 127-path staged integration was blocked on two authorization-classification findings plus one separate fail-closed receipt-storage internal error. A five-file repair preserved both triggering source records, passed the declared focused tests and internal authorization-state review against recorded artifact hashes, replayed the recorded 127-path staged surface, and evaluated the final 132-path state without blocks or internal errors. Residual failures remained visible, and neither passing result created execution or commit authority.
limitations: This is a repository-local, non-production episode completed before any operational AI task or runtime execution.
The authorization-state coverage is bounded to the implemented rules and evaluated states.
The cited validation record does not independently prove reviewer role separation or third-party validation.
Eight known repository-control baseline failures remained.
One inherited historical failure in an adjacent suite remained.
No customer, compliance, revenue, or market outcome was measured.
